verdict.rationale: Discord documents official SDKs: the Embedded App SDK for web apps and games inside Discord, and the Discord Social SDK, with getting-started guides for C++, Unity, Unreal Engine, and iOS/Android, plus extensive development guides covering account linking, provisional accounts and relationships. The evidence shows no official general-purpose SDK for the core REST/Gateway bot API, so bot and integration builders work against raw REST/WebSocket. missing for 10: an evidenced official SDK for the core bot/REST API in mainstream languages, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
